Quant__008_nvfp4_multimodal_embedding_pr.mechanism: The reference itself fails on ROCm, before any submission is involved. This is not a port gap that more work closes.
Quant__008_nvfp4_multimodal_embedding_pr.error: RuntimeError: scaled_gemm with `torch.float8_e4m3fn` scales of 1x16 blocks is only supported for CUDA 12.8 and above
Quant__008_nvfp4_multimodal_embedding_pr.why_not_substituted: MXFP4 (block 32, E8M0 scales) is the OCP format CDNA4 implements and it does work here -- a Triton dot_scaled kernel was compiled, launched and numerically verified (artifacts/07/spike.json). But NVFP4 is block 16 with FP8-E4M3 scales. Different block granularity and a different scale format give different quantization error, so an MXFP4 version of one of these problems is a re-specification, not a translation, and must never be presented as the NVFP4 problem.
Quant__008_nvfp4_multimodal_embedding_pr.revisit_when: ROCm gains a block-16 FP8-E4M3-scaled scaled_gemm path, or the benchmark adds MXFP4 problems under their own IDs with provenance back to these.
